author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear drives a mid-engined Toyota GR Yaris, which is a testbed for a future sports car. In fact, there might be two new Toyota sports cars coming, as the new turbocharged 400hp engine can go in the front or middle of a vehicle, meaning both a new Celica and a new MR2 could arrive in the next few years. The Porsche Cayman and Boxster might be dead, but Toyota is about the save the sports car!
